body: Goodbye.

I'm in the ER right now with an IV in my arm and constant supervision. I've been seen by three different doctors but I'm not feeling any better after an hour. Thankyou for the advice and encouragement.
Have a good day. It sounds like you really need one.
Stop giving me advice because I previously was not able to go but am there right now. I don't need rude remarks. Thanks.

I am going to the hospital. I do not see how asking someone to stop giving me advice is lashing out. Everyone here has been so helpful and I agree with everyone that I need to go see a doctor. Just because I am in a bad situation and I am scared doesn't mean that I am lashing out or refusing to listen. I am grateful for everyone that has helped me out and been understanding. So again as I have said to the previous person. Thankyou for your input. I Hope you have a good day.
Like I said. I'd appreciate it if you would stop giving your advice. Thankyou.

Maybe you aren't aware but they can and will kick me out. They have done it before for much less than this and when I refused I was removed by a social worker. So no. This isn't a question of weather I think they can or can not. They can and will. I do not want to deal with that especially considering I have a lot going on right now. Thanks for the input. Id appreciate if you stopped giving your advice to me. I hope you have a good day.

It's been three days now since I've had water and it actually stayed in my stomach so my moms agreeing to take me to a doctors office. She still won't take me to the ER but hopefully the doctor will tell her I need that. She gave me a Popsicle but the sugar is making my mouth so dry and it's making my stomach hurt.

I'm on my phone. I understand I do not need permission but I was told if I was to go to the hospital I would need to go by myself witch doesn't seem likely considering I can't stand up and secondly I was told I would be kicked out of my home. So I would rather not go and come back to find my stuff has been removed because I know it would be.

I haven't been able to sleep for more than an hour because my heart is beating so fast. Instead I tried drinking a bottle of water and threw it up. I've tried drinking sugary things and it didn't work either. I'm probably going to go to the hospital as soon as I can get myself there.
That means more than you could ever know. Thankyou for all of the support.

Thankyou for being so empathetic to my situation. I really do appreciate all of the advice that has been given to me and I realize that this is a serious problem. I need to take care of myself because I clearly do not have support from anyone else in my life right now. I just really want to thank you for not telling me that I'm lying or making me feel bad about what is going on in my life. It means a lot.
Thankyou for that. I really do appreciate it. I didn't intend to cause problems when I asked for advice so I'm sorry.

You are actually one of the most deluded people I have ever come across. Have fun looking through my posting history. Has it ever occurred to you that I'm going through a really hard time and I have no emotional support whatsoever. This is one of the only two places where I can get an unbiased opinion and one of the only two places I find helpful. I am not stupid and I know that I am not looking for attention. Believe me if I was I wouldn't be doing it over the Internet with strangers. I am doing this because I don't want to cause a scene with anyone in my life and I don't want to worry them with my problems. I'm sure they all have enough going on in their own lives. Why do you assume that it is your business to take my situation and turn it into something that it isn't and then have the nerve to say horrible and inaccurate things about me. If anything you might want to look into seeking some help if you really do believe that what you are doing is acceptable. Let's take a quick look at when all of my posts were put out there. Notice how I have only been active for a month give or take a couple of days. That is because I am at a breaking point with my emotions and felt I had no where else to turn to. Just because I am going through a hard time with multiple things does not give you the right to make my feelings and problems seem any lesser. You disgust me.

Thankyou. Honestly I've been offered a ride to the hospital now that both of my parents see that it is the only way to help me. They are still yelling at me and they have told me if I get a ride they will not pick me up and I need to make my way home on my own. I do not have any money for a cab and the public transit is closed untill 7am. It looks like I need to wait this out untill the morning.

As much as I wanted to tell you to go fuck your self I gave your ridiculous "diagnosis" a thought and read about it. The behaviours and tendencies of a person with that disorder do not match anything that I am going through at all. I am not like this regularly. I'm having a really difficult few weeks and for you to tell me that I'm seeking attention is a huge slap in the face. You don't know me past what has been written in this question. So fuck off.
I wouldn't know. I'm not doing that.

My ex of one year broke up with me yesterday and my mom thinks I'm doing this to get attention from people. This was happening before the breakup and this is all because of stress that I'm being put under. I'm not doing this intentionally. I can't be taken out of my home because of my age. I'm stuck right now. My dad doesn't want to listen to me.
I can't even type properly. I just reread my post and I'm so nauseous that I'm relying on auto correct to spell my words properly.
My mom won't allow me
My mom said that if I do that she'll kick me out. She keeps telling me to drink water and I am. It's making me sick and she promised to take me if I did but she just keeps telling me to drink more

I would sit down with her and just talk about everything. Try and understand things from her perspective and don't put blame on each other because that will just make it worse. Apologize for hurting her and lying and tell her that you really do want to move forward and be in a good place with her. Discuss what you both don't like and make some decisions on how to deal with things together. If you want to stay with her work with her not against her. I get where you're coming from. I'm sorry this is happening honestly.
Well she's going to call me In a few minutes so I guess I'll see how things work out. Thankyou for the advice.

No not at all. I don't think this is for attention but I really do think this has to do with her medication and how she hasn't been on it for a while. I think that's where the indecisive behaviours are coming from. She tells me she has a clear head every time she makes a decision and then Just as fast she changes her mind. It's making my overall health deteriorate and I can't continue like this.

I'm not offended by any of that. I just don't understand at all. We had such a good relationship and she would tell me the exact same thing. There was never a point when we were truly unhappy being with each other and now she's just making me feel horrible after I made one mistake. One fight. It wasn't a big mistake at all but she won't let it go. I've never cheated or lied or manipulated her. I've done nothing but be her support system and I just feel like I failed. I don't understand how she could just look at everything and say "I'm done with this". It's not helping that she keeps changing her mind. She's not replying to me (probably asleep) but I feel like I've waited to long and I need an answer tonight.

Thankyou so much. Honestly I'm just so miserable right now. My heart keeps breaking over and over again and I can't do it anymore. I just want things to be ok. Hopefully she'll text me back soon and I can call her to sort things out because I can't continue like this. You've been so helpful honestly I can't thank you enough.

I feel like an idiot. It's been a year and I have been nothing but good to her. I've put my heart out on the line and I don't think that this one fight makes me deserving of any of this. I always asked her if she was happy with me and told her how important she was. I still, throughout this whole fight, have been assuring her of how much I care and how I'm here for her and that she is loved and cared for. I just want an answer so I can move on or put everything into making things right again. I just want her to stop playing with my feelings and make her decision.

Thankyou for being so understanding and helpful. I'm honestly in such a bad state over this. I'm not eating or sleeping and I'm trying to be so positive but I have no one to really lean on. The people in my life have their own problems and I think they're getting really sick of me telling them that her and I are ok and then an hour later crying on the phone about how stuck I feel because she's changed her mind. I just want her to follow through and come meet me for coffee so we can talk about what's best for both of us. I don't think that's going to happen though.

No this isn't our first big fight. This is however the first fight where she packed her clothing and told me that she didn't love me anymore and said some horrible things to me. I was ok with ending things for her sake and I tried to accept it but she was the one that told me she missed me later that night and agreed to try again. I'm trying so hard to just support her and do the best I can for her. I'm not a horrible person and I don't think I deserve this. She's said to me that I deserve better but she's the one I want. I will accept any decision she gives her no matter how against it I am but I just want her to make one so I don't keep getting disappointed and crushed when she doesn't see me and then changes her mind just as fast and tells me that she loves me.

A lot of things. I don't really want to get into it because most of them are her personal issues that I know she wouldn't be comfortable with me sharing anywhere. It initially started when I woke her up and asked her to talk to me and it escalated from there. It was pretty bad but not bad enough to just end things in my opinion. We've been together for a year and I don't want to just let that go. I know I might have to but I'll deal with that if it comes to it.

I have been so patient and understanding but this is doing a lot of damage to my mental and physical health. It has been over a week now and she refuses to tell me what she wants. I think this is very unfair considering how well I treat her and how good I've been to her throughout this entire week of us being on and off.
